svg.text: (PACE silicon: RISC-V controller, 42% of die area)
Every CGRA resource is an ordinary
no custom instructions, no DMA needed.
64 PEs · 8 × 8 KB data memories (left + right) · 16 AGUs · 64b mesh
address decoder: [18:17] 00 PE / AGU · 01 data memory · 11 control
PE config word = two 32b writes (low word buffered, high word commits)
CTRL (start/stop) · STATUS (busy/done/stopped) · CYCLES · IRQ_EN · ID 0x13E · RUN_LIMIT
END = any AGU triggered at max count
config / data write bus (to every PE CM, AGU, DM)
memory PE (columns 0, 7): CM bit 59 triggers its AGU; load data → op1 two cycles later; store data = op1
compute PE: 16 × 64b config memory, 16b INT + 8 × FP8 ALU, 6 × 7 router (see PE diagram)
2 write AGU CM / ARF / MAX (edge PEs)
5 wait: poll STATUS.BUSY or take irq
6 read CYCLES, read results from DMs
CGRA host address map (byte offset in the 512 KB window; CPU address = 0x1000_0000 + offset)
PE config memory, entry e (0–15), low / high word
AGU instruction e {stride[7:4] width[3:2] const[1] store[0]}
AGU address register e (13b byte address)
data memory d (0–3) on left (side 0) / right (side 1)
CTRL · STATUS · CYCLES · IRQ_EN · ID · RUN_LIMIT
